sources.entry: cc-devops-skills by akin-ozer - Immensely detailed set of skills for DevOps Engineers (or anyone who has to deploy code, really). Works with validations, generators, shell scripts and CLI tools to create high quality IaC code for about any platform you've ever struggled painfully to work with. Worth downloading even just as a source of documentation.

summary.one_liner: A pack of 31 Claude Code and Codex skills for DevOps work, pairing generators that scaffold IaC, CI/CD, container, Kubernetes, observability and shell configs with validators that lint and security-check them.
summary.what_it_does: The repository ships 31 skills: 16 generators that scaffold configs and 14 validators that lint, security-check and dry-run them, plus one debugger (k8s-debug) for cluster troubleshooting. Coverage includes Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, Dockerfiles, Helm, Kubernetes YAML, Fluent Bit, Loki, PromQL/LogQL, Bash and Makefiles. The README describes validator pipelines that call real tools such as terraform fmt/validate, tflint, Checkov, helm lint/template, kubeconform, actionlint and act. Many validators run local shell or Python scripts and define fallback behavior when a tool is missing. It also publishes a drop-in GitHub Action wrapper around anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 that injects these skills by default. Installation is via the Claude Code plugin marketplace or a manual Codex plugin link.
use_cases: scaffold a Terraform or Terragrunt module with validation
lint and security-check GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins pipelines
generate Kubernetes manifests or Helm charts and validate them
troubleshoot pods stuck in Pending in a cluster
review infrastructure-as-code changes in pull requests
write and lint Dockerfiles, Makefiles and shell scripts
build Prometheus alert rules or Loki and Fluent Bit configs
how_to_run: brew install terraform tflint terragrunt helm kubeconform kubectl hadolint
brew install actionlint act shellcheck prometheus yq fluent-bit
pipx install ansible ansible-lint checkov yamllint molecule
helm plugin install (plugin URL not given in README text)
notable: Generator and validator pairs for each domain, so output can be checked right after it is produced
Validators run real tool chains such as terraform fmt, tflint, validate, Checkov and optional plan
Kubernetes validation detects CRDs and looks up their schemas before kubeconform and dry-run checks
Drop-in wrapper for claude-code-action that injects DevOps skills by default and can be disabled
Packaged as both a Claude Code plugin and a Codex plugin from one skills directory
caveats: Many validators need external CLIs (terraform, kubectl, helm, actionlint, act, etc.) installed; skills degrade gracefully when they are missing
Some paths depend on cluster access (kubectl dry-run, k8s-debug) and optional tools like terraform plan
Python 3.8+ baseline, with 3.9+ recommended for some security tooling
README does not state a maintenance status or release cadence
